name: TTC (Transtelecom)
verdict: Unit Telecom LLP holds 75% of Transtelecom and state railway NC Kazakhstan Temir Zholy — a Samruk-Kazyna asset — holds 25% (KASE register, July 2026).
note: Partner of Barys Astana for 2026/27 (club partnership page; logo on ttc.kz). Rating note (2026-10-03): the link — KTZ, a state asset of Samruk-Kazyna, holds 25% of Transtelecom per the KASE register as of 1 July 2026 (claim transtelecom-shareholders), above the 5% threshold; the record — kazakhstan-january-2022-killings. Majority owner Unit Telecom is private (Nurali Aliyev era ended 2025; a sale to Timur Turlov's entities was announced in Dec 2025 but not in the register by July 2026). Proposed tier: concern. ON HOLD pending maintainer review.

why.text: TTC (Transtelecom), listed as a Barys partner, is 25% owned by state railway Kazakhstan Temir Zholy, an asset of the state's sovereign fund Samruk-Kazyna. In Kazakhstan's January 2022 crackdown on anti-government protests 238 people were killed and officers later convicted of torturing detainees, with impunity persisting per Amnesty International.
why.messageLine: A quarter of TTC belongs to Kazakhstan's state railway, and the state's 2022 crackdown killed 238 people.
